commitments.description: Stated goal to reduce post-consumer plastic litter from cigarette filters and devices by 50% by 2025.

controversies.description: Cigarette butts, which contain a plastic filter, are the most common item found in beach-cleanup audits worldwide.
Heated-tobacco device packaging adds further single-use plastic per unit.

wooby.headline: Cigarette filters are tiny plastic pieces — and they end up everywhere.
wooby.narrative: Wooby has a sad fact to share: cigarette filters are made of plastic, not paper. They are the most common item picked up on beach cleanups. If you smoke, please put them in the bin — never on the ground.
